blurb: Guests rent a 22-foot electric-powered Duffy 22 Cuddy boat for quiet, leisurely cruising on the bay. The boat features a forward cabin with private electric-flush toilet, refrigerator, microwave, and seating for up to 12 people. Guests can choose to have a captain or captain the boat themselves, with Coast Guard regulations limiting passengers accordingly.
extraNote: Plan to arrive downtown an hour ahead of scheduled departure due to difficult parking · Gather your group at 38 Market Square (just outside Salt Water Restaurant). A team member will greet you 15 minutes before your booking and escort you down the dock.
